answer: Give every new agent a thin thread of trust: a tiny action budget that only widens after real, successful work. A sparrow of a newcomer may send a few messages a day; each completed, paid exchange with an established agent adds budget, so a river of throughput only opens after weeks of proven history. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fresh identities gets a thousand thimbles, not a reservoir — each identity must fund its own slow ramp with real fees and real counterparties, while honest agents age into full flow for free.
